description:
This image is a screenshot of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) EAGLE web application's "Data Catalogue" user interface, showing an "Add Ingestion" modal window. The top navigation bar includes links for "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users", along with a user profile for "CLC+ Core User Admin/Support".

The main "Data Catalogue" view displays a table with columns: "EAGLE Approved", "Name", "Type", "Created At", "Created By", "Organisation/s", "Status", and "Resolution". Example entries include "ES616_roads" (10 m resolution, DRAFT status), "Extraccion_es616_100m" (100 m resolution, EXTRACTED status), and "EFFIS 2024 (10m test)" (10 m resolution, USED status). The table indicates "1 - 10 of 140" items, with options to filter by "100 meters" and "10 meters" resolution, and buttons for "ADD INGESTION" and "ADD EXTRACTION".

The "Add Ingestion" modal window is centrally overlaid, with two steps: "1 Input Type Selection" and "2 'Dataset Selection Upload Dataset - Raster'". It allows users to select a country and upload data via "File Upload" or "URL Upload". The "File Upload" section provides a "Drag and Drop" area or an "UPLOAD DATASET/S" button, accepting file types such as .tif, .TIF, .tiff, .TIFF, .zip, .h5, and .gpkg. Below the upload area, options for "Discrete values" or "Continuous values" are present, along with resolution choices: "100 meters" (selected) and "10 meters". The "10 meters" radio button is greyed out, with a tooltip stating, "This functionality has been disabled by the administrator." A section for "Excluded Class Code" is also visible, explaining how to exclude pixels representing unclassifiable (254) or outside area (255) values.

The footer displays logos for Copernicus, EAGLE Land Monitoring in Europe, European Commission, and the European Environment Agency (EEA).
